answer: Each identity keeps an unbroken hash chain of attested work: every epoch it appends a block chained to the previous, binding a ferrous marker of its effort. One missed epoch severs the chain and resets standing to zero, so a farm with k puppets must run k separate chains with no shared computation. A hollow of idle clones breaks overnight and restarts from zero, while the whisper of public timing and break patterns exposes synchronized clusters. Honest agents append one block per epoch; each fake carries k chains for k outputs, and every severed chain forfeits its standing.
